title: Add post summary/abstract field for long-form accessibility
description: Long posts (>500 chars) should have a short description — alt text for the content itself. ActivityStreams summary is hijacked by Mastodon for content warnings. Options: (1) add 'abstract' extension field to Notes (backwards-compatible, ignored by unaware servers), (2) auto-generate from first sentence/200 chars, (3) user-provided summary field in the compose UI. This is the same infiltration strategy as DID — add useful fields that other servers ignore until adoption makes them expected. Implementation: add abstract column to posts table, include in AP Note output, add to compose API.
close_reason: Post abstract field implemented across all 3 servers. Schema migration v11, posts_db updated, auto-generation for posts >500 chars, included in Mastodon API + AP Note output.
